name: Mombasa
tagline: Kenya's coastal gateway — tourism, trade, and cultural fusion
description: Mombasa is Kenya's second-largest city and primary port. Known for white sand beaches, historic Fort Jesus, and vibrant Swahili culture. The economic engine of the Coast region.

name: Kwale
tagline: Home to Diani — Kenya's premier beach destination
description: Kwale County features Diani Beach, Shimba Hills National Reserve, and titanium mining operations. A growing eco-tourism hub.

name: Kilifi
tagline: Coral coast — marine parks, resorts, and Swahili heritage
description: Kilifi County stretches along Kenya's coast from north of Mombasa to Malindi. Famous for Watamu Marine Park, Gede Ruins, and the Sabaki River Estuary.

name: Tana River
tagline: The river county — irrigation, livestock, and renewable energy
description: Tana River County is named after Kenya's longest river. Primarily pastoralist with irrigated agriculture along the Tana. Home to the Tana River Primate Reserve and large-scale wind power projects.

name: Lamu
tagline: UNESCO heritage island — Swahili culture, dhows, and untouched beaches
description: Lamu is Kenya's oldest continuously inhabited town and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Car-free streets, traditional Swahili architecture, and the famous Lamu Cultural Festival.

name: Taita-Taveta
tagline: Safari capital — Tsavo's vast wilderness and gemstone mines
description: Taita-Taveta is home to Tsavo East and Tsavo West National Parks, Kenya's largest protected areas. Also known for gemstone mining (tsavorite, tanzanite) and the Taita Hills.

name: Garissa
tagline: Gateway to North Eastern Kenya — livestock trade and Somali heritage
description: Garissa is the largest county in the former North Eastern Province. A centre for livestock trade and cross-border commerce with Somalia.

name: Wajir
tagline: The frontier county — connectivity, livestock, and cultural richness
description: Wajir is Kenya's second-largest county by area. Emerging as a telecom and trade hub for the Northern region with growing mobile connectivity and livestock export markets.

name: Mandera
tagline: Kenya's north-eastern anchor — education and cross-border trade
description: Mandera is Kenya's easternmost county, bordering Ethiopia and Somalia. Known for its investment in education, livestock economy, and growing cross-border trade.

name: Marsabit
tagline: Lake Turkana's southern shore — volcanic landscapes and ancient culture
description: Marsabit County encompasses Mount Marsabit, the Chalbi Desert, and the southern shores of Lake Turkana. Rich in archaeological sites and wind energy potential.

name: Isiolo
tagline: Gateway to the north — wildlife corridor and cultural melting pot
description: Isiolo is the gateway to Northern Kenya. Home to the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy and a key stop on the route to Marsabit and Ethiopia. A cultural crossroads of Borana, Samburu, Meru, and Somali peoples.

name: Meru
tagline: The green county — tea, coffee, and the Nyambene Hills
description: Meru County is a major agricultural producer (tea, coffee, miraa, dairy) on the eastern slopes of Mount Kenya. Home to Meru National Park, the Nyambene Hills, and the Meru people's rich cultural heritage.

name: Tharaka-Nithi
tagline: Highland bounty — organic farming and academic excellence
description: Tharaka-Nithi is known for its highland agriculture (bananas, coffee, tea, macadamia, mangoes), scenic Nkunga Hills, and strong educational institutions including Chuka University.

name: Embu
tagline: The banana county — fertile slopes of Mount Kenya
description: Embu County lies on the southeastern slopes of Mount Kenya. Famous for its banana and coffee production, the Embu people, and the emerging tech scene centred around the Embu University.

name: Kitui
tagline: The sun county — mangoes, minerals, and Kenya's largest solar farm
description: Kitui is known for its mangoes, sisal, and mineral deposits (iron ore, limestone, gemstones). Hosts Kenya's largest solar power plant and is a leader in dryland agriculture innovation.

name: Machakos
tagline: The frontier city — rapid urbanisation and the new Nairobi satellite
description: Machakos is one of Kenya's fastest-growing counties, driven by Nairobi spillover development, Konza Technopolis, and Machakos University. A hub for real estate, education, and manufacturing.

name: Makueni
tagline: The fruit basket — mangoes, oranges, and dryland innovation
description: Makueni County is Kenya's leading mango and citrus producer. Known for innovative dryland farming techniques, the Makueni Fruit Processing Plant, and South Eastern Kenya University.

name: Nyandarua
tagline: The Aberdares highlands — Kenya's breadbasket and trout capital
description: Nyandarua County sits atop the Aberdare Range. Known for potato, wheat, and dairy farming, the Aberdare National Park, and trout fishing in cool mountain streams.

name: Nyeri
tagline: Kenya's coffee heartland — Mount Kenya's lush slopes
description: Nyeri is the heart of Kenya's coffee country, producing some of the world's finest Arabica. Also home to the Mau Mau caves, the tomb of Lord Baden-Powell, and stunning views of Mount Kenya.

name: Kirinyaga
tagline: Kenya's rice bowl — the Mwea irrigation scheme
description: Kirinyaga is Kenya's largest rice producer, powered by the Mwea Irrigation Scheme. Also known for coffee, tea, and the magnificent Mount Kenya National Park on its eastern slopes.

name: Murang'a
tagline: The tea and coffee county — birthplace of Kenya's independence heroes
description: Murang'a produces some of Kenya's finest tea and coffee. Rich in Kikuyu cultural history, home to the Kimathi Institute of Technology, and the scenic Mugumo-ini Falls.

name: Kiambu
tagline: Nairobi's northern bedroom — corporate headquarters and coffee estates
description: Kiambu County is the most populous in Kenya outside Nairobi. A major residential and industrial area with a booming real estate sector, numerous coffee estates, and technology parks.

name: Turkana
tagline: The cradle of humankind — Lake Turkana and Kenya's energy powerhouse
description: Turkana is Kenya's hottest county and the cradle of humankind (Koobi Fora). Home to Lake Turkana, the world's largest permanent desert lake, massive wind farms, and recent oil discoveries.

name: West Pokot
tagline: The highlands of the north — fertile valleys and gold deposits
description: West Pokot County features the Cherangani Hills, gold mining, and rich agricultural lands. Known for its Pokot culture, traditional beadwork, and Weyer's Cave.

name: Samburu
tagline: The wild north — rare wildlife and timeless Samburu culture
description: Samburu County is one of Kenya's premier wildlife destinations. Home to unique northern species (Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, Somali ostrich) and the vibrant Samburu culture.

name: Trans Nzoia
tagline: Kenya's granary — maize, dairy, and Kitale's agricultural legacy
description: Trans Nzoia is Kenya's leading maize producer. The fertile plains around Kitale also produce sunflowers, dairy, and pyrethrum. Home to Kitale Museum and the Saiwa Swamp National Park.

name: Uasin Gishu
tagline: The city of champions — world-class athletes and agricultural wealth
description: Eldoret is Kenya's athletic heartland, producing world champion runners. The county is also a major agricultural (wheat, maize, dairy) and manufacturing hub with a growing university town economy.

name: Elgeyo-Marakwet
tagline: The home of champions — Kerio Valley and the Rift Valley escarpment
description: Elgeyo-Marakwet is synonymous with Kenyan athletics (Iten is the training capital of the world). The Kerio Valley offers dramatic scenery, while the escarpment produces mangoes and traditional weaving.

name: Nandi
tagline: The tea highlands — Nandi Hills and Kenya's best milk
description: Nandi County produces world-class tea and dairy. The Nandi Hills are the traditional home of the Nandi people and the legendary Nandi Bear. Kapsabet is emerging as a university town.

name: Baringo
tagline: Lakes of the Rift Valley — flamingos, geysers, and geothermal power
description: Baringo County features Lake Baringo, Lake Bogoria (with its geysers and flamingos), and the Tugen Hills. A hub for geothermal energy development and birdwatching tourism.

name: Laikipia
tagline: Kenya's conservation capital — wildlife conservancies and Mount Kenya views
description: Laikipia County is a world leader in community-based conservation. Home to numerous private wildlife conservancies, endangered species breeding programmes, and the Mount Kenya equator crossing.

name: Nakuru
tagline: The lake county — flamingos, geothermal, and the Rift Valley's economic hub
description: Nakuru is Kenya's fourth-largest urban centre and the economic capital of the Rift Valley. Home to Lake Nakuru National Park (flamingos), Menengai Crater, Hyrax Hill, and growing geothermal and manufacturing sectors.

name: Narok
tagline: Maasai Mara — the world's greatest wildlife spectacle
description: Narok County is home to the Maasai Mara National Reserve, the Great Migration of wildebeest and zebra, and the Maasai people. The agricultural Lolgorien highlands and gold mining add economic diversity.

name: Kajiado
tagline: Nairobi's southern frontier — Amboseli, Kitengela, and Maasai ranches
description: Kajiado County stretches from Nairobi's southern suburbs to the Tanzanian border. Home to Amboseli National Park (Mount Kilimanjaro views), Kitengela Glass, and rapid urbanisation.

name: Kericho
tagline: Green gold — the world's finest tea and the Kipsigis highlands
description: Kericho is synonymous with tea production — some of the world's finest black tea. The rolling green hills, tea estates, and Kipsigis culture make it a unique destination.

name: Bomet
tagline: The tea and milk county — fertile highlands of the Kipsigis
description: Bomet County is a major tea and dairy producer, known for its high-quality produce and scenic highland landscapes. Home to the Tenwek Mission Hospital, one of Kenya's best rural hospitals.

name: Kakamega
tagline: The rainforest county — Kenya's only tropical rainforest and gold
description: Kakamega County features Kakamega Forest — Kenya's last remaining tropical rainforest — with unique bird and primate species. Also known for gold mining, sugarcane, and Masinde Muliro University.

name: Vihiga
tagline: The hills of Maragoli — academic excellence and scenic beauty
description: Vihiga is Kenya's most densely populated county. Known for the Maragoli people, the scenic Kisumu-Kakamega escarpment, and high educational attainment with many national scholars.

name: Busia
tagline: Kenya's western gateway — border trade and Lake Victoria fish
description: Busia is Kenya's busiest land border crossing with Uganda. A centre for cross-border trade, fish processing from Lake Victoria, and sugarcane farming.

name: Siaya
tagline: Land of the mighty lake — Luo heritage and Lake Victoria's bounty
description: Siaya County borders Lake Victoria, providing livelihoods through fishing. Birthplace of Jaramogi Oginga Odinga (Kenya's first Vice President) and home to the historic Bondo University.

name: Kisumu
tagline: Lakeside city — Lake Victoria's largest port and the heartbeat of Luo land
description: Kisumu is Kenya's third-largest city and the main port on Lake Victoria. A regional trade, manufacturing, and tourism hub with the Kisumu Impala Sanctuary, Hippo Point, and vibrant lakeside nightlife.

name: Homa Bay
tagline: Rusinga Island — fossil discoveries and Lake Victoria's hidden gems
description: Homa Bay County features Rusinga Island (fossil-rich), Mfangano Island, and the scenic Homa Hills. Fishing is the economic backbone, with growing tourism around Lake Victoria's islands.

name: Migori
tagline: Gold and sugarcane — the mineral belt of western Kenya
description: Migori County has significant gold deposits (Macalder mines) and extensive sugarcane plantations. Also borders Lake Victoria, providing fishing livelihoods. The Kuria people's unique cultural traditions add to its diversity.

name: Kisii
tagline: The soapstone county — bananas, education, and Kisii's entrepreneurial spirit
description: Kisii County is famous for its soapstone carvings, bananas, and high academic achievement. One of Kenya's most densely populated and entrepreneurial counties, with a vibrant SME sector.

name: Nyamira
tagline: The green highlands — tea, bananas, and panoramic valley views
description: Nyamira County sits on the highlands east of Lake Victoria. Known for tea farming, bananas, and the stunning Nyamira Hills viewpoints overlooking the Lake Victoria basin.

name: Nairobi City
tagline: The Green City in the Sun — East Africa's startup and economic capital
description: Nairobi is Kenya's capital and Africa's most dynamic startup ecosystem. A global hub for tech (Silicon Savannah), finance, and diplomacy. The only city with a national park within its borders.

name: Bungoma
tagline: The sugarcane county — Kenya's sugar belt and academic excellence
description: Bungoma County is the heart of Kenya's sugar industry, producing most of the country's sugarcane. Also known for its strong educational institutions, the scenic slopes of Mount Elgon, and the Bukusu cultural heritage.
